description: Defines the AudioDecoderPassthrough class which creates DecodedAudio objects from input buffers without decoding, used for passthrough audio playback on Android.

classes.name: AudioDecoderPassthrough
classes.description: A class that creates DecodedAudio objects from input buffers without decoding, used for passthrough audio playback.

methods.name: AudioDecoderPassthrough
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decoder with samples per second.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Processes input buffers to produce DecodedAudio objects and calls the output callback.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream by pushing an empty DecodedAudio.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves the next DecodedAudio object and outputs the samples per second.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing queued DecodedAudio objects.
